corpus.label: wikipedia-ios
index_build: xcodebuild -project Wikipedia.xcodeproj -scheme Wikipedia -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' ARCHS=arm64 -derivedDataPath "$BENCH_DERIVED_DATA" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build-for-testing
corpus.note: Pass the clone with --corpus <clone>@<commit>; `repository` is left out because a public file cannot name a local path. warm null: not built, so every check is answer-based or restored. index_build is for arm B's index store only; it needs no setup step.

preamble: This repository cannot be built or tested here: answer from its source. Paths are repository-relative.
answer_rule: End your reply with exactly one line that starts with ANSWER: and holds only the answer in the form the task asks for.

tasks.prompt: Where is the method invalidateForYouCache(project:) declared? Give the repository-relative file path and the line its declaration starts on, as path:line.

Which files call the Year in Review data controller's method shouldShowYearInReviewSettingsItem(countryCode:), from Swift or from Objective-C (an Objective-C call spells it shouldShowYearInReviewSettingsItemWithCountryCode:)? Count test files too, but not the file that declares the method. Give file names only, comma-separated.
Which files call forYouBecauseYouReadIsOn() on the Home data controller? Count test files too, but not the file that declares the method. Give file names only, comma-separated.
The struct WMFLocalNotificationLogEntry has a nested enum named Event. List every case of that enum by its Swift case name, comma-separated.

The protocol YearInReviewBadgeDelegate is adopted by types that declare it on a line of the form `extension T: YearInReviewBadgeDelegate`. List the type names T (not the files), comma-separated. A class that only inherits the conformance from a superclass does not count.

A toast reading "This passage is no longer in the article" can appear after the user opens an article from a semantic search result. Which file and which function decide to show that toast (the function that calls the toast API, not the one that holds the string)? Give the repository-relative path, a colon, then the function name with no parentheses, as `path: function`.

A toast reading "Donation reminders can be modified anytime in Settings." is shown after the user dismisses the in-article donation reminder card. Which file and which function show it? Give the repository-relative path, a colon, then the function name with no parentheses, as `path: function`.
In the Home feed, articles I have already seen in the last month keep coming back. Find the cause in the source and fix it with a minimal change.

A donor set a reminder to be shown after reading 3 articles. After they read exactly 3 articles in the current cycle the in-article reminder card does not appear; it only appears once they read a fourth. Find the cause in the source and fix it with a minimal change.

Three linked questions, each needs the previous answer. (1) Which case of the enum WMFUserDefaultsKey has the raw value "home-feed-see-first"? Give the case name. (2) Which public method of WMFHomeDataController returns the value stored under that key? Give the method name with no parentheses. (3) Which file under WMFComponents/Sources calls that method? Give the file name only. Answer with the three parts separated by ` | `, as `case | method | file`.
